angles.usefulInsight: For a professional seeking greater responsibility, describing completed work leaves an important question unanswered: how did you decide what was worth doing? The carousel should unfold that distinction across five slides: open on the missing decision record; distinguish delivery from judgement; show what a readable decision account contains, such as the options and the trade-off; explain how marked work makes that reasoning inspectable; then invite the reader to try the three-call exercise. The reader learns to make their reasoning visible rather than merely add stronger adjectives to their achievements.

Where our members come from
02The problem
Careers are continuous. Career infrastructure is not.
Every other so-called “career community” solves one moment and stops, if that. Nothing connects search to performance, so careers grow in bursts and then flatten.
The proof never gets made. You get better at the work and nobody outside the room can see it.
Four tools, four logins. A board for the search, a course for the skill, an app for the interview, a community for the people.
The career lives across tabs. Jobs in one place, notes in another, and the follow-up that would have mattered lost in memory.
AI is changing what high-impact work looks like.
Leverage is going up. So is the cost of a bad call. What a good seat asks of you has moved.
Start with the problem you have today.
Choose your starting point.
I need better jobs and better outcomes.

A feed built around your role, seniority and city, and the application, outreach and referral request written from your record. Every role is open free, with 5 Job Assists to start: messages to hiring managers, referral requests or application forms.
I need to be in management and not just execution.

Most of us feel the need to move up the ladder, but rarely do we take the actions that get us there. You are not missing leadership opportunities because you are not good. Rather, you are ONLY good at execution, NOT decisions.
I need a career that I can be proud of.
Jobs, training, community, rewards, and more, under a single annual membership plan. Designed to give your career a proper support system, not limited to the next outcome alone.

Common questions.
What is Proving Ground?+

A cohort-based programme that builds judgement, problem solving and decision-making under uncertainty. Capability work inside one simulated company, module by module, then Career Translation turning the work into a portfolio and a plan. It includes 6 months of the Intelligent Job Board (Foundation plan).
What does it cost, and how do I pay?+

₹34,999 (list price ₹39,999), with 6 months of the Intelligent Job Board included. You book your seat with a part payment and pay the balance before the cohort starts. A counsellor confirms fit on a call before you pay anything, and there is a 7-day, no-questions-asked refund from booking.
How is it taught?+

Real cases from real companies (80+ interactive case studies), short action-framework lessons, framework practice, mentor-led live cases, integrated simulations where each decision follows from the last, and feedback marked against a published standard. Case studies, self-paced lessons, masterclasses and the simulation engine are all live today.
How much time does it take each week?+
Six to eight hours a week: a live session, a simulation, and the reading. Sessions run in IST and are recorded.
Who marks the work?+

Written decisions are marked against a rubric with five written levels, and the feedback comes back in plain language as a conversation about the call you made. Mentors run the live cases and mark the room. Multiple-choice decisions are scored the same way every time, so two people who make the same call get the same score.
Who is it for?+

People with a real capability, judgement or proof gap: switchers moving into product, Founder's Office, operations, growth or finance work, and builders sharpening decisions they already make. It is not for someone who wants a certificate.
What do I leave with?+

Careers changed. Career infrastructure did not.

A career used to be a ladder inside one company. Founder's Find is the layer that stays: the opportunity, the selection, the capability, the proof and the people, connected.
